svg.text: FORGE: RESEARCH GAP & ARCHITECTURAL NOVELTY COMPARISON (§2.4)
Contrasting Coarse Commercial Difficulty Mechanics with FORGE's End-to-End Closed-Loop Telemetry Personalization
Existing Systems
FORGE Closed-Loop
Novel SOTA
EXISTING COMMERCIAL & PCGRL MECHANISMS
Fragmented / Open-Loop
COMMERCIAL DDA
HADES (Supergiant Games) — "God Mode"
Player ──► Death Count ──► Hardcoded Formula (+2%/death) ──► Scalar Resistance
• Only adjusts a scalar resistance percentage (up to +80% damage reduction)
• Completely blind to playstyle, weapon selection, and combat pacing
Critical Limitation: Zero spatial or enemy archetype adaptation; purely reactive scalar.
STATIC LOOKUP TABLES
DEEP ROCK GALACTIC (Ghost Ship Games)
Player Count + Hazard 1–5 Preset ──► Static Table ──► Scaled Swarm Stats
• Multi-parameter scaling (damage, velocity, attack intervals) exists but is static
• Scaling is driven by co-op lobby size and manual hazard tier selection
Critical Limitation: Unaware of individual player performance; static discrete presets.
TIME MONOTONIC
RISK OF RAIN 2 (Hopoo Games)
Elapsed Session Clock ──► Monotonic Multiplier ──► Exponential Stat Inflation
• Difficulty increases strictly as a function of continuous elapsed time
• Disproportionately punishes methodical exploration and looting playstyles
Critical Limitation: One-directional difficulty ramp; zero feedback on player distress.
LITERATURE BENCHMARK
CONTROLLABLE PCGRL (Earle et al. [2])
Handcrafted Designer Vector ──► Conditioned PPO ──► Generated 2D Grid
• Pioneered conditioning RL generator policies on explicit target metric vectors
• Operates in Sokoban/Zelda tile editing without combat physics or player loops
• Target vector must be manually supplied by an external human designer
Critical Limitation: NO autonomous inference from live player combat telemetry.
THE THREE DISCONNECTED TRACKS IN EXISTING SOTA:
[A] Procedural Dungeon Generation (Dead Cells, Returnal)
Static seeds, grammar rules, zero online telemetry adaptation.
[B] Multi-Parameter Difficulty (Deep Rock Galactic, DRG)
Rich parameter spaces, but set via static presets / co-op counts.
[C] Coarse Adaptation (Hades God Mode, Left 4 Dead)
Adapts to deaths/health, but 1D scalar rules; never reshapes levels.
THE RESULT: No system autonomously closes the loop from telemetry to PCG.
THE FORGE CLOSED-LOOP ADAPTIVE PARADIGM (THE SYNTHESIS)
Autonomous Telemetry Conditioning
FORGE UNIQUELY SYNTHESIZES PRIOR ART [A + B + C] WITH FOUR NOVEL CAPABILITIES:
[D] Continuous In-Process Telemetry Inference ──► [E] Conditioned PPO Generator Policy (Sub-0.5ms)
[F] Combinatorial Difficulty Vectors (E + M + Rooms) ──► [G] Dual Regressor & Glass-Box Explainability
STEP 1: INPUT
Human Player Combat Engagement (Player.gd & Shop.gd)
• Player maneuvers in 2D top-down dungeon, attacks enemy archetypes, triggers traps, purchases upgrades
Gear Progression (Shop.gd): Weapons, Armor, Boots normalize player combat power into Combat Rating (CR)
STEP 2: TELEMETRY
Telemetry Ingestion & 8-Dim Observation Normalization (DifficultyManager.gd)
• On Exit Portal reached: Computes level performance deltas (Δt vs T*=45s pace, Δdeaths, Δdamage)
Synthesizes Observation Vector S_t ∈ [0, 1]^8: [norm_time, norm_deaths, norm_dmg_ratio, norm_hp,
norm_dmg, norm_haz, norm_rooms, norm_level]
STEP 3: PPO INFERENCE
Pure GDScript PPO Forward Pass (PPOPolicy.gd — Latency < 0.5ms)
• Evaluates S_t through 3-layer MLP: 8 ──► Dense(64, Tanh) ──► Dense(64, Tanh) ──► Output(8)
• Zero external Python/PyTorch runtime: Executed via native vector dot products in engine memory
• Outputs Continuous Action Vector a_t ∈ [-1.0, 1.0]^8 | Automated Fallback Heuristic if weights missing
STEP 4: PARAMETER SPACE
Combinatorial Parameter Denormalization: x_k = L_k + ((a_k + 1)/2) · (U_k - L_k)
• Adversary Vector (E): Health [20, 120 HP], Damage [5, 50 Dmg], Speed [60, 220 px/s], Aggro [100, 450 px]
• Environmental Modifiers (M): Hazard Density [0.05, 0.80 Trap Ratio], Resource Scarcity [0.10, 0.90 Drop Inv]
• Macro Topology & Archetypes: Room Count Target [5, 9 Chambers], Softmax Archetype Distribution
STEP 5: GENERATION
Procedural Dungeon Synthesis (DungeonGenerator.gd — Solvability ≥ 95%)
• Frontier random walk graph builds connected topology starting at (0, 0) [START] and ending at [EXIT]
• A* Pathfinding guarantees unbroken traversal | Archetype Softmax distributes 5 distinct enemy AI classes
• Instantiates active TileMap and physics nodes directly into Godot engine viewport
STEP 6: EXPLAINABILITY
Difficulty Attribution & Defense Suite (DefenseOverlay.gd / SHAP)
• Glass-Box Linear Attribution: Difficulty Score DS ∈ [0, 100] = Σ w_k · x_k_norm
• Surfaced on Live In-Game HUD: Top-3 parameter drivers (e.g. 35% Enemy Dmg, 25% Traps, 20% Speed)
• Real-time transparent auditing for evaluators, eliminating black-box opacity
CLOSED
LOOP
CORE RESEARCH CONTRIBUTION (STATED PLAINLY):
While existing titles force the human player to adapt to an indifferent, static world or coarse 1D presets,
FORGE continuously observes live player combat capability and autonomously reshapes both the spatial topology and adversary ecology to preserve psychological flow.
